digest.component_or_area: Documentation — git workflow and contributor discipline
propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree after a Gerrit merge completes, before closing the ticket, to ensure the merged rebar-ticket commit is reachable from HEAD for the close precheck.
The shared main checkout must never be fast-forwarded, reset, or stashed by any agent or contributor, as it may contain uncommitted operator WIP that would be clobbered.

The close completion verifier (_referencing_commit_exists) reads git log over the repo and needs the merged commit reachable from HEAD (ref=HEAD) to validate the work landed, making post-merge worktree synchronization a prerequisite.
Documentation in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must explicitly state the two-part post-merge discipline: fast-forward your worktree only, never the shared checkout.
